$comment: Label catalogue of drnachio/postext. Every issue takes exactly one type:, one or more area:, and any topic: that applies. Sync with `node .github/scripts/sync-labels.mjs` (renames listed under `from` keep their history). See CONTRIBUTING.md › Labels.
